# mtncloud_deployment_version (Resource)

A version of a deployment. Its content is files uploaded to MTN Cloud (`type = "file"`, with `mtncloud_deployment_file`), a git repository (`git`), or a URL MTN Cloud fetches when it deploys (`fetch`). Everything here changes in place. Destroying it deletes the version and its files; what was deployed stays on the instances.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Files uploaded to MTN Cloud, with mtncloud_deployment_file.
resource "mtncloud_deployment_version" "v2" {
  deployment_id = mtncloud_deployment.web.id
  version       = "2.0.0"
  type          = "file"
}

# A git repository at a tag.
resource "mtncloud_deployment_version" "from_git" {
  deployment_id = mtncloud_deployment.web.id
  version       = "2.1.0"
  type          = "git"
  git_url       = "https://github.com/example/web-site.git"
  git_ref       = "v2.1.0"
}

# A URL MTN Cloud downloads when it deploys.
resource "mtncloud_deployment_version" "release" {
  deployment_id = mtncloud_deployment.web.id
  version       = "2.2.0"
  type          = "fetch"
  fetch_url     = "https://downloads.example.com/web-site-2.2.0.tar.gz"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_id` (String) The deployment, for example `mtncloud_deployment.web.id`. Changing it makes the version in the other deployment.
- `type` (String) Where the content comes from: `file` (uploaded with `mtncloud_deployment_file`), `git` or `fetch`.
- `version` (String) The version's name, for example `1.4.0`.

### Optional

- `fetch_url` (String) With `type = "fetch"`: the URL MTN Cloud downloads when it deploys.
- `git_ref` (String) With `type = "git"`: the branch, tag or commit. Leave it out for the repository's default.
- `git_url` (String) With `type = "git"`: the repository's URL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the version.
- `status` (String) The version's status, for example `created`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The deployment's ID, then / and the version's ID.
terraform import mtncloud_deployment_version.v2 <deployment_id>/<version_id>
```
